title: Tuwaiq Agent Broker Protocol v1
description: Structured Tool Request/Response protocol between the Python AI agent and the Rust broker (tuwaiq-agent-broker). Transport-agnostic: v1 uses newline-delimited JSON over a local Unix domain socket (or stdin/stdout for the CLI prototype).

protocol_version.description: Protocol version. Broker rejects any request whose version it does not support.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this request, generated by the Python agent. Echoed back in the response for correlation and audit-log matching.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the Python agent created this request.

tool.description: Name of the tool being invoked. Must exactly match one entry in the broker's Tool Registry. Any other value is rejected as unknown_tool.

arguments.description: Tool-specific arguments. Validated per-tool by the broker (see per-tool schemas below). Read-only tools take no arguments (empty object).

request_id.description: Echoes the request_id from the corresponding ToolRequest.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the broker produced this response.

result.description: Present only when status == ok. Tool-specific result payload.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to show to the end user or log. Never includes raw stack traces or internal paths.
